linkedin.text:
🚨 You spent $60 on that technical book.

Three months later, you can't remember if chapter 7 even existed.

Searching the PDF gives you page numbers, not answers. Asking your agent gets hallucinations. Taking notes produces a 200-line doc you never open.

**book-to-skill fixes this by turning books into structured agent skills.**

Point it at a PDF, EPUB, or DOCX → it distills the book into frameworks, decision rules, per-chapter files, and a glossary → your agent loads the right chapter on demand and answers from the real content.

No hallucination. No token waste. The book becomes part of your workflow.

✅ Works with GitHub Copilot CLI, Amp, and Claude Code
✅ Uses 24×–51× fewer tokens than dumping the book into context every session
✅ Supports PDF, EPUB, DOCX, Markdown, HTML, RTF, MOBI, and more

Over ⭐ 1,400 stars on GitHub.

Next time you read a technical book, install it as a skill and just ask `/your-book-slug replication` — the agent reads the right chapter and answers.

💡 Search GitHub for "book-to-skill" and check the README.

What's the last technical book you bought but never reference anymore?
